description: This dataset is constructed to match published means and confidence intervals; it is not original experimental outputs

assumptions.normality: Underlying values assumed normally distributed before truncation
assumptions.truncation: Values truncated to the interval [0,1]; location calibrated iteratively to match each reported mean within 1e-3
assumptions.independence: Trajectory values treated as independent within each model-generation group

checks: Generated confidence-interval halfwidths are computed as 1.96*sample_sd/sqrt(n), with sample_sd using ddof=1.
